What if you drank hot water every morning?
Drinking warm water in the morning is a common habit in many parts of Asia. Many people say it wakes up their stomach. Lots of people swear it helps them feel warm and hydrated.

But here's the twist. Warm drinks can help get your gut moving, but very hot drinks above sixty five degrees Celsius are linked to a higher risk of throat cancer. So let it cool a bit! Warm or cold, the most important thing is drinking enough water every day. Tea and coffee lovers can simply wait a few minutes before sipping.
